title: Give the team_fifa_api_id of teams with more than 50 but less than 60 build
question:

Benchmark knowledge evidence: teams with more than 50 but less than 60 build-up play speed refers to buildUpPlaySpeed >50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed <60;
